calibration_leakage_rule: a residual enters calibration only after actual clear AND logged record receipt; each previously issued prediction immutable
evaluation: empirical coverage with temporal-block uncertainty when adequate blocks exist
fresh_test_period_proposal: [2026-10-13T00:00:00 Europe/Kyiv,2026-11-13T00:00:00 Europe/Kyiv); only if prospectively logged and unseen when approved; do not call existing October 1–11 independent again
guarantee: No distribution-free time-series coverage claim; exchangeability/shift/dependence assumptions not established
input_contract: same UID/source; append-only received_at, source updated_at if supplied, response hash, exact row version; no overwriting historical input versions or issued forecasts
interval_recipe_proposal: single precommitted online absolute-residual conformal-style radius: all available completed past residuals from this fixed point method, rank ceil((n+1)*0.9), [max(0,p-q),p+q]; no interval if rank exceeds n; no interval tuning on the new test
target: prediction interval for total registered Kyiv alert duration at start, same point forecast rolling30
user_acceptance: user and error costs unvalidated; practical gain, allowed underestimation rate, coverage and width constraints must be agreed before this experiment
